**Plan**, no edits made.

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js:11) already gives full rows, `owner` and `slow` included. `toTable()` in [format.js](src/format.js:14) drops those two on purpose for width.

So: add a `--json` check in [cli.js](src/cli.js:8), and on that branch print `JSON.stringify(buildRows())` instead of `toTable`. Same data, full fields, no changes to `report.js` or `format.js` needed.

Want me to make that change?
